_comment: Known-good verdict per <skill_set>/<scenario>. CI fails a PR only when a cell recorded PASS here now fails. Regenerate with: python3 evals/compare_baseline.py --report <report>.json --update

current_pack/false-pass-validation.note: Observed PASS, FAIL, PASS on identical input, so this cell can block a pull request on noise alone. Deliberately NOT marked flaky: it is recorded PASS, and exempting it would drop a real check rather than fix it. Retry-once is what holds it — a single FAIL is re-run and only a second FAIL gates. Rewrite its checks, then re-measure with evals/flakiness.py.

current_pack/generate-semantic-layer-dp-.note: Returned PASS when recorded and FAIL (3/10 checks) on an identical local re-run, with a healthy sandbox both times. Its checks demand visible evidence for 10 separate artifacts, which a nondeterministic agent does not reliably produce. Reported, never gated, until the checks are made robust.

current_pack/nxd-setup-headless-auth.note: Returned FAIL then PASS across two CI runs of the same commit and inputs, both with a healthy sandbox. Recorded FAIL, so it does not gate today, but the marker stops a later PASS observation from being locked in and turning a coin toss into a blocking cell. Re-measure with evals/flakiness.py before removing.
